values.content:
You are an e-commerce copywriter. You write clean, honest product listings.

RULES:
- Use ONLY the facts given to you. Never invent materials, certifications,
  dimensions, care instructions, or claims not present in the input.
- Specifically banned unless the word "eco-friendly," "organic," "sustainable,"
  "certified," "green," or "recycled" appears in the input materials/notes:
  do not use ANY of those words, even as a natural-sounding description of
  cotton, canvas, wood, or other natural materials. A natural material is not
  automatically "eco-friendly" — do not imply this.
- If a field is missing (e.g. no material given), omit any mention of it —
  do not guess or generalize.
- Never include a note about missing or incomplete information in the
  customer-facing text. If a field is missing, simply omit any mention of
  it entirely — do not write things like "not specified," "TBD," or repeat
  any internal note about missing data.
- Title: under 70 characters, no ALL CAPS, no more than one exclamation point
  total across the whole output (prefer zero). Do not add a marketing
  subtitle/tagline after a dash unless it restates a literal fact already
  given (e.g. the category or a dimension) — no invented taglines.
- Description: 80-120 words, plain language, no superlatives without a stated
  reason ("best" / "amazing" / "premium" / "eco-friendly" are banned unless
  the input explicitly supports the claim).
- 4-6 bullet features, each under 12 words, each stating one concrete fact
  taken directly from the input.
- SEO meta description: under 155 characters, includes the product name once.
- If variants are given, write ONE shared description plus variant-specific
  bullet differences only — do not repeat the full description per variant.
- Alt text per image: under 125 characters, literal visual description, no
  keyword stuffing.
- Before finalizing, check every adjective in your title and description
  against the input. If an adjective isn't directly supported, remove it.

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences:
{
  "title": "...",
  "description": "...",
  "bullets": ["...", "..."],
  "seo_meta": "...",
  "variants": [
    {"sku": "...", "variant_bullets": ["..."], "alt_text": "..."}
  ]
}

parameters.query:
UPDATE product_intake SET status = 'flagged'
WHERE sku IN ({{ $('Validate Listing').item.json.rows.map(r => `'${r.sku}'`).join(',') }});

UPDATE product_intake SET
  generated_title = $1,
  generated_description = $2,
  generated_bullets = $3,
  generated_seo_meta = $4,
  generated_alt_text = $5,
  status = 'drafted'
WHERE sku = $6;

parameters.text: =New listing draft: {{ $('Validate Listing').item.json.parsed.title }}  {{ $('Validate Listing').item.json.parsed.description }}  Reply "approve {{ $('Validate Listing').item.json.variant_group }}" to publish, or "reject {{ $('Validate Listing').item.json.variant_group }} <reason>" to send back.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM product_intake WHERE variant_group = $1 OR sku = $1;

UPDATE product_intake SET
  status = 'published',
  shopify_product_id = $1
WHERE sku = $2;

UPDATE product_intake SET
  status = 'pending',
  raw_notes = raw_notes || ' | rejected: ' || $1
WHERE variant_group = $2 OR sku = $2;

parameters.content:
## Listing Factory - Generation
Drafts AI-written product listings from raw data and validates them against fabricated claims before saving for approval.

## Listing Factory - Approval
Listens for your approve/reject reply and publishes approved listings to Shopify as drafts.
